My dear [Miss Gatty](/person/469)

I have read [Miss Caillard](/person/250)’s first chapter and I cannot help thinking her work promises to be what you would like for Aunt Judy.[^1]

I think she would be willing to wait if you have not room to begin immediately

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Horatia Katherine Frances Gatty (b. 1846), younger sister of Juliana Ewing, was editor of Aunt Judy\'s Magazine.

Emma Marie Caillard (1852-1927) is probably referred to.
